title: Yet Another Vanilla Refresh
description: A modpack that brings together mods that try to improve and upgrade vanilla experience
body:
- This modpack includes many optimization mods, extra features for resource packs and shader support, new particles, enhanced fog and darker nights.

- Changed world generation, extented vanilla biomes and new ones, redesigned structures, overhauled Nether and End dimensions.

- More use for copper, cheaper rails, improved horses, new combat with new weapons such as daggers, maces and flintlock guns.

- New decorative blocks, with new placement alowing vertical slabs, stairs and carpets.
